skill.name: Lunge
skill.description: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

skill.name: Skip 'n Slash
skill.description: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

passive.name: P - Thousand Cuts
passive.description: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

skill.name: Snip Snip!
skill.description: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

skill.name: Hallowed Mist
skill.description: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

skill.name: Needlework
skill.description:
Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit.

This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

passive.name: Thousand Cuts
passive.description: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

skill.name: Killer Instinct
skill.description: Kai'Sa dashes near an enemy champion.

skill.name: Swirlseed
skill.description: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.

skill.name: Relentless Pursuit
skill.description: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

skill.name: The Call of the Pack
skill.description: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

skill.name: Eviscerate
skill.description: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.

skill.name: Hounds' Pursuit
skill.description: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.

passive.name: We Are More
passive.description: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.

skill.name: Darkin Daggers
skill.description:
Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.

Packmates leap to attack champions hit by this skill.

skill.name: MMOOOMMMM!
skill.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

skill.name: Achooo!
skill.description: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.

skill.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
skill.description: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

skill.name: Yordle Snap Trap
skill.description: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.

skill.name: Ace in the Hole
skill.description: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

passive.name: Hemorrhage
passive.description: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.

passive.name: League of Draven
passive.description: Draven gains his fans' Adoration when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or tower. Killing enemy champions grants Draven bonus gold based on how much Adoration he has.

skill.name: Judgment
skill.description: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

skill.name: Dragon Strike
skill.description: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.

passive.name: Whisper
passive.description: Jhin's hand cannon, Whisper, is a precise instrument designed to deal superior damage. It fires at a fixed rate and carries only four shots. Jhin imbues the final bullet with dark magics to critically strike and deal bonus execute damage. Whenever Whisper crits, it inspires Jhin with a burst of Move Speed.

skill.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
skill.description: Jinx fires a super rocket across the map that gains damage as it travels. The rocket will explode upon colliding with an enemy champion, dealing damage to it and surrounding enemies based on their missing Health.

skill.name: Inner Flame
skill.description:
Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.

Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

passive.name: Unseen Threat
passive.description:
Nearby enemies that are Isolated from their allies are marked. Kha'Zix's abilities have interactions with Isolated targets.

When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, he gains Unseen Threat, causing his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow them for a few seconds.

skill.name: Leap
skill.description: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Wings</font>, Leap's range increases by 200 and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.

skill.name: Alpha Strike
skill.description: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.

skill.name: Hammer Shock
skill.description: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

skill.name: Poison Trail
skill.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

skill.name: Fling
skill.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

skill.name: Three Talon Strike
skill.description: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.

skill.name: Mourning Mist
skill.description: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that damages, slows and marks enemies.
